BEFORE WE GET STARTED

A little clarity
before you start.

What do I get with a template?

Editable website source files, the included demo assets, and setup instructions. Each product page lists its exact contents. Hosting, a domain, and customization are separate unless specifically included.

Can you customize it after I buy?

Yes. Use the customization inquiry option and include your template name and order reference. We’ll agree on the changes, price, and timeline before work begins.

Do I need to know how to code?

These are code-based templates. Basic HTML and CSS knowledge helps if you plan to edit the files yourself. If you prefer help, request customization and launch assistance.
